description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for git p4 integration, specifically focusing on excluded paths during clone and sync operations. It sets up repositories, performs clone and sync actions with various exclusions, and checks the correctness of these operations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleanup function to reset the Git environment after tests.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into Git with optional exclusions.

methods.name: git p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes Git repository with Perforce, with optional exclusions.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce source control.

methods.name: p4 edit
methods.description: Marks files for editing in Perforce.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup routine to run after the test.
